payload.final_answer: To identify a historic site that meets the specified criteria, I will first research historic sites constructed in the 1800s that are listed on the National Register of Historic Places. I will then look for information on the owners of these sites, focusing on their personal asset valuations between 1860–1863 and their dates of death in September between 1876 and 1878. Finally, I will check the proximity of these sites to an airport with a runway length of 3,400 feet.
